note: What a person's worlds connect to, as the Integrations page lists it (integrations.ts; DESIGN's build sheet of 24 October and WORDS.md). One catalog over the model providers and the door: each row names where its state is read from, the words for each state, its Connects, Reads and Goes to lines, its guide (a document under docs/ and one of its headings, opened at guides) and its mark, a plain line drawing in a 24 by 24 box. A row whose state this install cannot give is left out. Each row's guest words are what a guest, or an account on a hosted server, reads in their place: only what this server offers, and nothing a guest sets up or can end. verify-integration-words.mjs holds every guide to a heading that exists.

rows.name: Nebius Token Factory
rows.line: Open models from their makers answer for your people, with your own key, usually for a fraction of a cent a decision.
rows.connects: The open models offered with your Nebius key, each from its maker, priced per million tokens.
rows.reads: What a person's model is told at a decision, word for word as that decision's page shows it.
rows.goes_to: Nebius Token Factory, with your key. The key stays on this computer and is sent only to them.

guest.line: Open models from their makers answer for your people, from this server's budget, usually for a fraction of a cent a decision.
guest.connects: The open models this server offers, each from its maker, priced per million tokens.
guest.goes_to: Nebius Token Factory, under this server's own key.

rows.name: A model on this computer
rows.line: A local model runner answers here, free, and nothing it is told leaves this computer.
rows.connects: The models your runner holds that this install offers, each checked here before a person may choose it.
rows.reads: What a person's model is told at a decision, word for word as that decision's page shows it.
rows.goes_to: Nowhere else: your runner answers on this computer.

guest.name: A model on this server
guest.line: A local model runner answers on this server, free.
guest.connects: The models this server's runner holds and offers, each checked here before a person may choose it.
guest.goes_to: Nowhere else: the runner answers on this server.

groups.label: Outside programs, through a world's door

rows.name: A game
rows.line: A game plays someone in your world, or brings its own character in, under a grant you give and can end.
rows.connects: A game you admit on this install, for one of your people or a character of its own that comes in through the gate.
rows.reads: What the world's own models are shown for that person, and the world's rules in words.
rows.goes_to: The game, under the grant you give it.

guest.goes_to: The game, on your own install.

rows.name: An AI agent you build
rows.line: Any framework, through MCP or NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit, decides for someone you grant it.
rows.several: Each grant ends by itself at most a day after it was given.
rows.connects: An agent you run, with a key you hand it, for one of your people or a body of its own that comes in through the gate.
rows.reads: What the world's own models are shown for that person, and the world's rules in words. Every line it says is shown as an AI's.
rows.goes_to: The agent you run. You can end the grant at any moment, and the person's own routine decides again.

ends.refused: It could not be ended just then; it still stands.

guest.goes_to: The agent you run, on your own install.
